description: In front of you on the bed are a gray plastic tub holding small clear ice pieces, a yellow cup to the left, and a purple scoop/holder on the right. The left hand grasps the yellow cup as a left-hand object, lifts it over the tub, tilts it to dump ice into the tub, then rotates it upright and sets it back down to the left, while the right hand stays resting on the purple tool as a right-hand object without moving it.
